t: r/Ceramics on Reddit: bottom of my piece cracked :( can anyone tell me why this might have happened?
s: October 2, 2021 - Clay shrinks faster where it is thinner so if you have thick base edges and thinner bottom in the middle, the thicker band will dry slower and shrink slower. The middle base will be pulled apart if it's thinner. Clay is also stronger where it is thicker so this makes it easier to crack where it's thinner. It's good to understand how drying moves the clay around. Spirals unwind, thin areas shrink faster and more. Pay attention it's fascinating.
